title: design
text:
design

Maria: Heads-up — dropping a new "mini scrubber" for the rollout timeline this afternoon. Compact view that shows canary/A-B slices inline. Quick design review pls (screenshot in Figma).
Jake: Nice, looks tidy. Question: what happens to tap targets on small slices on mobile? :thinking_face:
Maria: Good call. Intend to have 44px min hit area; visual slice can be smaller but expand on hover/focus. Keyboard nav: left/right moves between slices, Enter opens details.
Sam: How are we exposing rollback? Inline action on a slice or separate details panel? Inline rollback feels risky if it's too discoverable.
Maria: Proposal: primary click = view traffic details. Overflow/menu includes Promote/Rollback. Rollback requires confirmation modal and keyboard focus trap. Inline quick-undo toast displayed after rollback.
Aisha: Accessibility nits: each slice needs an aria-label like "Canary 5% — Variant B — started Mar 28" and role="button". Announce allocation changes via aria-live="polite". Ensure reduced-motion preference respected for the scrubber animation. Also check contrast: selection ring on small slices needs 4.5:1 on small text — current mock looks ~3:1.
Jake: Agree on aria-live. Also show numeric % overlay on top of slices (small text) so screenreader + sighted users both get quick readout. For animations, fade instead of slide to be gentler.
Maria: We'll add numeric overlay and tooltip copy. Copy tweak idea: replace "Promote" with "Increase traffic" (PM asked for clearer wording). Thoughts?
Sam: I think "Increase traffic" is ambiguous when multiple variants exist. "Promote variant" is clearer about intent. Also ensure operations show pending/disabled state if an increase is already in-progress.
Maria: Good point — go with "Promote variant". We'll add disabled state, skeleton for pending updates, and toast linking to deployment logs. Also include aria-describedby referencing a status element.
Lee: :thumbsup: One more microcopy nit — hover tooltip for tiny slices should be short: "Canary (5%) — Variant A". Keep same pattern across locales (avoid full sentences).
designbot: Design review requested by Maria for `mini-scrubber-v2`. Reviewers: Jake, Sam, Aisha, Lee. Deadline: 3 days. :calendar:
Maria: Thanks folks — updating Figma now. Quick follow-up: adding keyboard shortcut `v` to open variant menu; will add docs for screenreader sequence. Ping when done.
